services.name: Aerial Yoga
services.desc: Take your yoga practice to the air literally with OUTDOOR Aerial Yoga! This specialty and unique style of yoga uses a hammock to strengthen, support and suspend your body. Open up energy lines and loosen fascia and connective tissue, while having FUN! The hammock is used as a tool to rock and soothe sore and tight muscles and minds. Expect to release tension on your bones and muscles, increasing flexibility and strength. This is an introduction to Aerial Yoga and suitable for all levels. services.name: Pool SUP Yoga
services.desc: Experience mindfulness mixed with challenge and adventure as you take your practice from land to water! Beginners at yoga and SUP are welcome! services.desc: Bretton Woods offers enriching School Programs designed to complement classroom learning with hands-on outdoor education. Tailored to fit a variety of grade levels and curriculum goals, activities include ecology studies, wildlife observation, conservation projects, team challenges, and outdoor skills development. services.desc: Bretton Woods Wild Child Camp: focuses on the Five Fundamentals of the outdoors that include: Shelter Building, Fire Starting, Water and Food, Orienteering and Signaling.
